_preset: Clean broadcast — strict thresholds with 30s boundary snapping
_description: For clean off-air captures, cable recordings, and digital-to-analog transfers with reliable black slugs. Strict detection with require_div5 enabled — US TV commercials are exact multiples of 15s/30s/60s/90s, so any candidate not near a 30s boundary is likely a false positive or a show transition. alwaysKeepFirst/Last protect cold opens and credit sequences. Produces the cleanest possible cuts for archival export.

_tuning_notes.pixTh_lowered: 0.08 → 0.06: clean source = cleaner black; stricter threshold reduces false positives
_tuning_notes.picTh_raised: 0.98 → 0.99: clean broadcast slugs are nearly 100% black
_tuning_notes.mergeGap_lowered: 1.5 → 1.0s: clean source has clean slug separation; tight merge avoids false joins
_tuning_notes.minCommercial_raised: 5 → 14s: shortest real US commercial break is ~15s; 14 filters station IDs
_tuning_notes.maxCommercial_lowered: 240 → 185s: longest standard US break is ~3 min; 185 filters overlong false breaks
_tuning_notes.uniformMaxStddev_lowered: 8 → 6: clean broadcast slates are near-perfect uniform; tight threshold
_tuning_notes.sceneThreshold_raised: 0.40 → 0.45: clean source has hard cuts; higher threshold avoids cross-dissolve noise
_tuning_notes.silenceNoiseDb_lowered: -40 → -45 dB: broadcast audio floor is cleaner; -45 avoids false silence
_tuning_notes.alwaysKeepFirst_15: Protects cold opens, pre-credits sequences, and recording start padding
_tuning_notes.alwaysKeepLast_15: Protects credit sequences and post-show content
_tuning_notes.minShowSegment_raised: 30 → 60s: broadcast show segments are long; 60s prevents mid-segment false cuts
_tuning_notes.requireDiv5_true: US TV ads are exact 15/30/60/90s multiples — non-multiples are not real ad breaks
_tuning_notes.reencode_true: Frame-accurate cuts for archival master; slow but exact
_tuning_notes.dryRun_true: Always verify plan before committing reencode pass

_div5_behaviour.snap_logic: Candidates within 3s of a 30s multiple are accepted as-is. Candidates outside tolerance but where snapping produces a duration within [minCommercial, maxCommercial] are snapped and tagged 'div5_snapped'. All others are dropped.

_signals_expected: uniform_overlap (frequent: broadcast uses clean black/white slates)
high_scene_rate (strong signal: broadcast ads cut rapidly)
div5_snapped (when boundary was adjusted to 30s multiple)
_confidence_note: With all four corroborating signals firing, commercial confidence reaches 1.13 (clamped to 1.0). Expect most cuts to show '★★★' in the activity log. Inspect any cut showing '★★☆' or lower before removing dry-run.
